grammar.Game/village interaction: Order a drink for the tea stall.
Label a stall delivery.

grammar.Pattern: 不 negates a verb or 是
grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 不 / 喝 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Choose a visitor's requested drink.

grammar.Chinese example: 你 / 喝 / 茶 / 吗
grammar.Game/village interaction: Complete a visitor request.

grammar.Pattern: Question word stays in its answer position
grammar.Game/village interaction: Find the missing order item.
Identify a resident in a portrait scene.
Attach the right object to its owner.

grammar.Pattern: 的 can be omitted with close family
grammar.Game/village interaction: Recognize both natural ownership forms.

grammar.Pattern: Adjectival predicate with 很, without 是
grammar.Game/village interaction: Choose the matching kettle state.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 没 / 有 / 钱
grammar.Game/village interaction: Read the stall purchase condition.

grammar.Chinese example: 家 / 里 / 有 / 人
grammar.Game/village interaction: Place residents in the correct home.
Find a resident on the village map.
Place a delivery on a highlighted surface.
Find the visitor's destination.
Pack a kitchen order.

grammar.Pattern: 两 versus 二 before classifiers
grammar.Game/village interaction: Fill a home with the requested residents.
Choose a specific cup, not every cup.
Select the school's requested book.

grammar.Pattern: 几 versus 多少 in quantity questions
grammar.Game/village interaction: Complete a housing count; contrast with 多少钱.
Order a resident's schedule.

grammar.Chinese example: 三 / 月 / 一 / 日
grammar.Game/village interaction: Assemble a festival date; include year in separate rounds.
Set a work-start time.

grammar.Pattern: Age with 岁; normally no 是
grammar.Game/village interaction: Complete a resident's profile.
Assign a household together.

grammar.Chinese example: 我们 / 都 / 喝 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Serve a group with one shared request.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 也 / 喝 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Add another resident to an order.
Complete a second resident's dialogue turn.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 想 / 买 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Order a visitor's purchase request.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 会 / 写 / 字
grammar.Game/village interaction: Assign a resident to a suitable school task.
Choose an available helper from a scene.
Seat a guest in the pavilion.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 买 / 了 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match a finished purchase to its sentence.

grammar.Pattern: Sentence-final 了 signals a changed situation
grammar.Game/village interaction: Recognize the new weather state.

grammar.Pattern: 没 negates a past action; omit completion 了
grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 没 / 买 / 茶
grammar.Game/village interaction: Distinguish an unfilled order from a completed one.

grammar.Pattern: 太...了 expresses a strong degree
grammar.Game/village interaction: Adjust the tea-stall scene.

grammar.Pattern: 怎么样 asks for an assessment
grammar.Game/village interaction: Select the matching customer response.

grammar.Pattern: 怎么 asks how an action is done
grammar.English: How do I get to school?
grammar.Game/village interaction: Choose the correct route scene.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 去 / 买 / 茶
grammar.English: I am going to buy tea.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match a trip to its purpose.

grammar.Chinese example: 你 / 来 / 不 / 来
grammar.Game/village interaction: Accept either affirmative or negative visitor reply.

grammar.Pattern: 正在 / 在 + verb marks an ongoing action
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match an animated resident, not a finished task.
Choose the open-door scene; contrast with 开了.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 去 / 过 / 北京
grammar.Game/village interaction: Identify a visitor's travel history.

grammar.Chinese example: 没 / 去 / 过 / 北京
grammar.Game/village interaction: Complete a travel-history reply with implied subject.
Check a completed kitchen request.

grammar.Chinese example: 他 / 还 / 在 / 工作
grammar.Game/village interaction: Compare current and finished work scenes.
Prepare a repeat visitor request.
Send a visiting group on its route.
Read a temporary room instruction.
Choose a permitted action at the guesthouse.

grammar.Chinese example: 明天 / 可能 / 下雨
grammar.Game/village interaction: Prepare shelter for a possible weather event.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 要 / 去 / 学校
grammar.Game/village interaction: Assign a destination from an intention.
Deliver to the named recipient.
Assign a helper through a short instruction.

grammar.Chinese example: 他 / 跑 / 得 / 快
grammar.Game/village interaction: Compare runners in a recreation scene; 跑 is a taught component of 跑步.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 吃 / 完 / 了
grammar.Game/village interaction: Recognize finished work; later use 看见 and 听懂.
Choose movement toward the speaker; contrast with 进去.

grammar.Chinese example: 从 / 家 / 到 / 学校
grammar.Game/village interaction: Connect two map locations.
Guide a visitor without translating direction labels.

grammar.Chinese example: 学校 / 离 / 家 / 近
grammar.Game/village interaction: Pick the matching map layout.

grammar.Chinese example: 我 / 比 / 他 / 高
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match the correct resident-height scene.

grammar.Chinese example: 这 / 个 / 最 / 贵
grammar.English: This one is the most expensive.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Select a stall's highest-priced item.
Set a repeated schedule; 天 is a separately taught time component.

grammar.Chinese example: 工作 / 三 / 个 / 小时
grammar.Game/village interaction: Fill a schedule duration, contrasting 点 with 小时.

grammar.Chinese example: 第 / 三 / 个 / 人
grammar.Game/village interaction: Select a position in a queue; 第 is taught from 第一.

grammar.Pattern: 因为...所以... links cause and result
grammar.Chinese example: 因为下雨 / 所以我在家
grammar.English: Because it is raining, I am at home.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Assemble each clause first, then link the two familiar chunks.

grammar.Chinese example: 我想去 / 但是没有钱
grammar.English: I want to go, but I have no money.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Pair an intention with the contrasting constraint.

grammar.Pattern: 为什么 asks for a reason
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match a reason to a visitor's situation.

grammar.Pattern: 就 connects a condition/time to a result
grammar.English: When he comes, I will go.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Sequence two resident actions using prebuilt clauses.
Choose the outfit described by the phrase.

grammar.Chinese example: 他 / 对 / 我 / 好
grammar.Game/village interaction: Match a helpful interaction; distinguish 对 meaning correct.

grammar.Pattern: Verb reduplication softens a brief action
grammar.Game/village interaction: Inspect a stall item; introduce as a phrase, not two new words.

grammar.Pattern: A small amount with 一点儿 (edition extension)
grammar.Game/village interaction: Choose a small portion; optional edition-bridge stage.
Compare mild discomfort with 一点儿 quantities; optional extension.

grammar.Chinese example: 虽然下雨 / 但是我想去
grammar.English: Although it is raining, I want to go.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Link two previously practised clauses in an optional bridge stage.

grammar.Pattern: 要...了 announces an imminent event
grammar.Game/village interaction: Distinguish approaching weather from current rain.

grammar.Pattern: 是...的 focuses a past event's circumstance
grammar.English: It was yesterday that I came.
grammar.Game/village interaction: Two-step visitor puzzle: assemble 昨天来, then frame the event; chunked target.
